human.problem: The oven-smoke joke comes right after the whole city of Gibeah is put to the sword (Judges 20:37) and as it goes up in smoke (20:40). The joke targets Papa Dorin, not the people. Even so, it lands on a mass-killing moment.
human.question: Can Papa Dorin joke at moments of mass death in a passage, like a city being put to the sword and burned, as long as the joke is about himself? Or should those moments carry no humor? The docs say his personality fits the moment and that he goes for a laugh when the moment can hold one, but they don't say whether moments like this can.
